page.content:
Twelve-inch articulated soldier that coined the action figure.

How G.I. Joe (1964) connects

  • Faction: Hasbro — Hasbro launched the 12-inch G.I. Joe in 1964.
  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — The 12-inch soldier came before the 3¾-inch Real American Hero line.

What is G.I. Joe (1964)?

The 1964 G.I. Joe was Hasbro's posable 12-inch fighting man — marketed as an action figure, not a doll — the toy that the later 3¾-inch Real American Hero line inherited in name.

Key threads lead to Hasbro and G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero.
